visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a three-panel split-screen layout. The top panel features a high-quality illustration of a male character with flowing light-blue hair and sharp yellow eyes, wearing intricate blue and white armor. The middle panel shows a close-up view of a circular game minimap and various UI icons from the game 'Honor of Kings.' The bottom panel displays an animation of a character's legs submerged in swirling water. (2) The scene transitions into full-screen gameplay footage from 'Honor of Kings,' though still utilizing a modified layout. A character moves through a top-down jungle environment, engaging in intense combat. High-contrast blue energy waves, ice crystals, and dragon-shaped effects erupt as the character uses abilities against multiple enemy heroes. The camera follows the action closely, with damage numbers floating above characters. (3) The editing pace increases with rapid cuts between different combat encounters. The screen flashes with bright white and blue light as ultimate abilities are triggered. HUD elements show health bars depleting and kill notifications appearing at the top. The background consists of stylized green brush and grey stone terrain typical of a MOBA arena.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-intensity Phonk music track starts immediately, characterized by a distorted, heavy bass kick and sharp snare hits at a fast tempo. A young male voice provides an excited greeting in Mandarin. (2) Sharp 'shing' and 'clash' sound effects trigger as the combat begins, synchronized with the heavy rhythmic beat. A female game announcer voice provides multi-kill notifications like 'Double Kill' with a reverberant, authoritative tone. (3) The audio becomes hyper-dense as overlapping 'whoosh' sounds from spell casting and 'impact' sounds from character deaths saturate the mix. The BGM remains continuous and driving, maintaining a high arousal level. The male commentator makes brief, high-energy exclamations over the music.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase a high-skill 'highlight reel' of the character Ao Yin in the game Honor of Kings, demonstrating effective use of abilities and combat strategy to engage and impress the gaming audience.
